modalLead: A fix for the preview card, which offered a play button on every hover card in v1.13.4 — including pages that hold no video at all.

items.text: Only a video gets a play button. The card asked where a player might be and took any answer: markup with no frame in it resolved to the dashboard's own address, which on an https install is a valid https address and passed for a player. Every hover card drew a black rectangle with a play mark on it. The bookmark's own address decides now, the same way the ▶ on the row does.
